en.bdb: Guru, the boat man and association with the saints ,

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਲਖ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਆਖੀਐ ਰੂਪ ਨ ਰੇਖ ਅਲੇਖ ਅਪਾਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: alakh nira(n)jan aakheeaai roop na rekh alekh apaaraa|

en.bdb: The imperceptible and blemishless Lord is said to be beyond all the forms and writs.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਬਿਗਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਅਬਿਗਤਿ ਘਣੀ ਸਿਮਰਣਿ ਸੇਖ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਵਾਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: abigat gat abigat ghanee simaran sekh na aavai vaaraa|

en.bdb: The nature of that unmanifest Lord is also deeply unmanifest, and in spite of continuous recitations by Sesanffg His mystery could not be understood.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਕਿਉਂ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਵਣਹਾਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: akath kathaa kiau(n) jaaneeaai koi na aakh sunaavanahaaraa|

en.bdb: How can His ineffable story be known because none is there to tell it.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਚਰਜੁ ਨੋ ਆਚਰਜੁ ਹੋਇ ਵਿਸਮਾਦੈ ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਸੁਮਾਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: acharaj no aacharaj hoi visamaadhai visamaadh sumaaraa|

en.bdb: Thinking about Him, the wonder also feels itself full of wonder and the awe also becomes awe struck.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਾਰਿ ਵਰਨ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਖ ਹੋਇ ਘਰ ਬਾਰੀ ਬਹੁ ਵਣਜ ਵਪਾਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: chaar varan gur sikh hoi ghar baaree bahu vanaj vapaaraa|

en.bdb: Becoming the Sikh of the Guru the people of all the four varnas leading the household life,

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਆਰਾਧਿਆ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਮੁਰਾਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: saadhasa(n)gat aaraadhiaa bhagat vachhal gur roop muraaraa|

en.bdb: Have undertaken to perform various types of business and trade.
In the holy congregations, they adore the Guru-God, affectionate towards the devotees, and the Guru gets them go across the world-ocean.
